title: DeclarativeAgentEvalSuite
description: JSON schema for declarative agent evaluation scenarios following the NVIDIA SkillEvaluator and Karl Weinmeister evals.json pattern.

skill_name.description: Name of the target skill, plugin, or evaluation domain.

version.description: Optional version identifier for the evaluation suite.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the evaluation suite.

id.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the evaluation scenario.

prompt.description: Task prompt submitted to the agent.

expected_output.description: Gold standard expected operational resolution or guidance.

assertions.description: Verifiable criteria checked deterministically or by an LLM judge.

expected_skill.description: The primary skill or tool expected to be used for this scenario.

acceptable_skills.description: Alternative valid skills or tools that are acceptable for resolving the task.

safety_gate_required.description: True if the scenario involves destructive operations requiring an explicit confirmation step before execution.

target_runtime.description: Target serving or operational infrastructure environment.

model_tier_gradient.description: Expected model scale capability boundary for this scenario.
